recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is needed unless a future issue reintroduces XPath metadata or defines AIDC search semantics for Device UDI carrier.
issue_request: FHIR-18080 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification OO change request asking to add missing expressions to STU3 Device search parameters for Device-model, Device-udi-carrier, and Device-udi-di. The final issue comments narrowed Device-model to Device.modelNumber, Device-udi-di to Device.udiCarrier.deviceIdentifier, and deferred HRF/AIDC details to FHIR-19288.
initial_application: The Jira comment identifies commit 9d8ee7f71d35a16a7dd17e9249f90f3b0f8beda8, which updated the then-authoritative Device spreadsheet search parameter rows. Current source has since refactored those definitions into source/device/bundle-Device-search-params.xml.
additional_context: Device is active in source/fhir.ini and remains an OO resource. FHIR-19288, a Published/Persuasive with Modification same-artifact decision, limited the UDI carrier search parameter to HRF until AIDC search semantics could be demonstrated. The current SearchParameter structure has SearchParameter.expression but no SearchParameter.xpath element.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. source/device/bundle-Device-search-params.xml already defines Device-model with Device.modelNumber, Device-udi-carrier-hrf with Device.udiCarrier.carrierHRF, and Device-udi-di with Device.udiCarrier.deviceIdentifier.

related_jiras.note: Same Device UDI carrier search-parameter family; explains why current source intentionally keeps only the HRF carrier search expression.
